The property

Room to settle in by the river

An entire waterfront cottage on the Ottawa River, about 25 minutes from Pembroke. An easy drive: about 1.5 hours from Ottawa, 4 hours from Toronto and 4 hours from Montreal. Bring the group, then split your time between the water, the warmth and the view.

  • Barrel sauna
  • 5-person hot tub
  • Private sandy beach
  • Stone fireplace
  • River views
  • Beachfront bar

Things to do in winter

Make a day of it

Snowmobiling the Valley

Groomed OFSC trails minutes from the cottage. Check the trail map for conditions.

Ski at Calabogie Peaks

Downhill and night skiing, roughly an hour's drive. An easy day trip.

Skate the shoreline

Skate the frozen bay or walk the snowy beach. Outdoor rinks in Pembroke too.

Winter winery visit

Tastings at WhiteWater O'Brien Winery. Check their seasonal hours.

The at-home winter day

Sauna circuit, fireplace and board games, dinner from Ullrich's on the BBQ.

Cold plunge in the river

Follow the sauna with an icy dip in the Ottawa River, the true Nordic way. Check conditions first.
